source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 20 May 1967, p. 8 ("Tyrone rural council nominations: no contests in Omagh and Castlederg")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Read from the Strabane Chronicle's report of the Tyrone rural nominations, 20 May 1967, p. 8.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. There were no contests: all sixteen seats were filled unopposed. The only change was in Castlegore, where E. C. H. Young took the place of the retiring Independent, J. T. Smyth. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Magheracregga' to Magheracreggan (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Castlederg Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Magheracreggan; the rounds were filed as Magheracreggan (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964); Magheracregga (1967). This round was filed as 'Magheracregga', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (magheracregga) answers with a redirect to this one.
